newsitem.title: USA: Continucare to manage 17 health facilities.
newsitem.headline: Continucare to manage 17 health facilities.

text.p: Continucare Corp said on Monday that it has an agreement with Healthcare America to manage 17 outpatient mental healthcare facilities.
Continucare said the deal is expected to increase its revenues by about 50 percent once it is fully implemented in the next several months.
The company did not immediately return a telephone call seeking further information.
Continucare currently manages 28 outpatient mental and physical rehabilitation programs in four states.
